purpose: Inputs for the nozzle-load check algorithm (VC-PST-15). Table values are grade B (secondary, possibly copied from one another) and never gate; the gate is the arithmetic of the check given these inputs.

api610_table5_nps6_usc.source: S21/S22: midstreamcalculator.com API 610 Table 5 page and an Eng-Tips post (search extracts, 2026-10-18); standard: API 610 12th ed. 2021 (catalogue S23)
api610_table5_nps6_usc.rule: component <= 2 x table (Annex F F.1.2a); table values are allowable ranges +/- value
